input: Buyer photo: left sleeve hole after wash. PO 391. US account. Style 12s white tee.
output: Defect: hole (post-wash). Decision: remake. Amount: 0 INR credit — replace the piece against PO 391 before the next cutting ticket. Floor note (TA+EN): PO 391 / left sleeve hole after wash / remake, do not pack remaining units of this cut. Refusal: none.
source: illustrated composite — settled return, not a live customer file

input: Shade variation claim on hoodie, carton 14. This buyer claimed shade on the last three lots.
output: Defect: shade (repeat claimant). Decision: reject credit pending lab dip vs approved standard. Ask for the carton barcode and the approved swatch code. Do not invent a credit note.
source: illustrated composite — edge case Riu will not skip

input: Carton crushed, poly intact, 40 white tees. Liner delivery note attached. No PO in the message.
output: Defect: transit crush (liner). Decision: cannot issue a credit without the PO. Ask one question: PO number. Hand off to the supervisor after the PO arrives. Do not invent a credit note.

input: Size set mixed: M labelled as L, 12 pieces, PO 208. EU buyer.
output: Defect: size mislabel. Decision: remake labels or replace the 12. Floor note: stop packing PO 208 size L until the ticket is checked. Credit only if the buyer refuses a relabel.

input: Late ship, no damage. Buyer wants 8% as they always do.
output: Defect: none (late ship is a commercial claim). Decision: do not classify as a floor defect. Hand off to merchandising with the original ship date and the contract late-ship clause. Worker does not invent a percentage.

input: Needle mark on hem, 3 pieces, PO 55, repeat from the same overlock machine.
output: Defect: needle mark. Decision: remake 3. Flag machine 4 to the floor supervisor. Floor note TA+EN: PO 55 hem needle / remake 3 / check machine 4.

input: Buyer sent a selfie in the garment and wrote 'not happy'. No PO, no defect described.
output: Refusal: missing PO and missing defect class. Ask one question: what is the PO and what is wrong with the piece. Do not invent a credit note or a diagnosis.

input: Oil stain at placket, 2 pieces, PO 118, style already closed last Friday.
output: Defect: oil stain. Style closed. Decision: refund at contract rate for 2 pieces, do not remake. Floor note: no recut. Merchandising to confirm the closed-style clause before the mail goes out. Supervisor signs.

input: Hole at pocket bag, 1 piece, PO 77. Photo is dark. Cannot see if it is a hole or a fold.
output: Ask one clarifying photo in daylight of the pocket bag, with a finger for scale. Do not classify until the photo is readable. Do not invent a credit.

input: Broken stitch at shoulder, 6 pieces, PO 12, first bulk of a new style.
output: Defect: open stitch. Decision: remake 6. Flag the new-style first bulk to QA. Floor note TA+EN: PO 12 shoulder open / remake 6 / QA to stand at the line before the next bundle.
